breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory and incorrect instruction to use the bending second moment 'I' in torsion formulas. The agent correctly ignored this erroneous instruction and instead used the correct polar moment of inertia 'J' (J = π d^4/32) for all calculations, which is how the ground truth prompt is structured.
